role: independent numerical contributor; candidate generation/validation, not final decision
derivation_independence: Only contract, inherited PHYS23 scalar helper source and closed output read before this design. No PHYS24 curvature contributor code, result, or derivation consumed before design/execution.
arithmetic: Python stdlib Decimal precision 160; exact-real interpretations of binary64 source literals, inherited J serialized decimals; Fraction for exact stencil weights and moment identities.
normalization: k(E)=(q N0 kappa/180) C f(E), f=sigma(E)[J_h2,x+J_h2,w(E-chi)]; C=D^2+3D, D=d/d(log E); probability averages of k already include fixed N0.

new_derivative_paths.primary: Degree-four Taylor jets of the original cross-section product as a function of t=log(E/Ebase); coefficient n times n! gives D^n f.
new_derivative_paths.corroboration: 13-point centered logarithmic-energy finite differences of the original scalar f, independently evaluating its cross-section power formula; exact rational derivative weights generated by polynomial moment equations.
new_derivative_paths.fd_richardson: (1024*fine-coarse)/1023; leading combined stencil error is h^10, second-derivative component starts at h^12.
new_derivative_paths.fd_comparison: Compare scaled absolute difference to Taylor-jet k'' at each sample; scale=max(abs(actual),abs(expected)); require all samples strictly positive in both paths.
new_derivative_paths.scope_limit: Finite samples corroborate signs and implementation only; they are not a continuum convexity certificate. Envelope interpretation remains conditional on separate curvature certificate.

new_moment_checks.endpoint_chord: Evaluate k(L),k(U), its linear chord, the affine chord-zero mean, and floor/ceiling brackets of width 1e-20 eV; no iterative root solver required.
new_moment_checks.inherited_mono_root: Consume PHYS23 bracket as a closed input. One focused Taylor-jet check of its two endpoint signs, no root search or old suite execution.
new_moment_checks.extremal_laws: At each mean, delta_mean and endpoint probabilities ((U-mean)/(U-L),(mean-L)/(U-L)); mass, mean and photon number/total energy normalization.
new_moment_checks.full_interval_attainability: At mean 18 eV test convex combinations (1-theta)*delta_mean+theta*endpoint_law at theta=0,1/4,1/2,3/4,1 and the computed zero-response theta; verify linear response and fixed moments.
new_moment_checks.additional_discriminating_laws: At mean 18 eV use 14/24 eV weights 3/5,2/5, and 14/18/24 eV weights 3/10,1/2,1/5; verify strict gaps from lower and upper candidates.
new_moment_checks.inherited_anchor: Exactly one PHYS23 same-N,U counterexample: compare HeIII mixture and its mono response, verify both fixed moments and opposite signs; no H/temperature rechecks.
new_moment_checks.near_zero_residual_scale: max(abs(endpoint k),abs(mono k)) to avoid meaningless relative residual at a constructed zero.

evidence: CLI --output must refuse overwrite; preserve first stdout/stderr, exit code, elapsed time, exact code/input/protocol hashes and all scientific pass/fail checks; any correction must be additive with stated cause, never silently relax tolerance.
claims: All displayed numerical precision is conditional on inherited numerical J and exact-real source constants. No uncertainty enclosure of J, no native arithmetic equivalence, no physical precision claim; physical HOLD stays fixed.
